description.en: The generic carbon-fibre 5-inch quadcopter frame class: four 16 × 16 mm M3 motor mounts on a 225 mm motor-to-motor diagonal, a 30.5 × 30.5 mm stack, a 19–20 mm camera bay and 20 mm battery-strap slots. A class, not any one vendor's design.
description.es: La clase genérica de marco de cuadricóptero de 5 pulgadas en fibra de carbono: cuatro montajes de motor M3 de 16 × 16 mm sobre una diagonal de 225 mm entre motores, una pila de 30.5 × 30.5 mm, un hueco de cámara de 19–20 mm y ranuras para correa de batería de 20 mm. Una clase, no el diseño de un fabricante.
description.fr: La classe générique de châssis de quadricoptère de 5 pouces en fibre de carbone : quatre fixations moteur M3 de 16 × 16 mm sur une diagonale de 225 mm entre moteurs, une pile de 30,5 × 30,5 mm, une baie caméra de 19–20 mm et des fentes de sangle de batterie de 20 mm. Une classe, pas la conception d'un fabricant.
description.pt: A classe genérica de quadro de quadricóptero de 5 polegadas em fibra de carbono: quatro fixações de motor M3 de 16 × 16 mm numa diagonal de 225 mm entre motores, uma pilha de 30,5 × 30,5 mm, um compartimento de câmara de 19–20 mm e ranhuras de correia de bateria de 20 mm. Uma classe, não o desenho de um fabricante.

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the flight-controller stack pattern, on the top face of the arms (the face the motors and the stack sit on, z = 0). +x points forward (toward the camera), +y to the left, +z up toward the top plate. Motor mounts sit at (±motor_half_x_mm, ±motor_half_y_mm, 0), each with x_axis pointing outward along its arm; the battery-strap station on the top plate's upper face at z = top_plate_z_mm; the camera bay's side-screw axis at (camera_axis_x_mm, 0, top_plate_z_mm / 2). The side plates' inner faces sit at y = ±camera_bay_width_mm / 2, each framed on the side-screw axis. Their outer faces sit at y = ±(camera_bay_width_mm / 2 + side_plate_thickness_mm), framed on the same axis. The rear 20 × 20 mm VTX seat sits on the top plate's upper face at (rear_mount_x_mm, 0, top_plate_z_mm).

Female: the bay receives the camera body. Origin on the side-screw axis midway between the side plates; symmetry 0, so a mate's angle_deg is the camera tilt.

Male: the side plate carries the camera side screw's head; its clearance hole sits on the side-screw axis. Origin where that axis meets the plate's INNER face; the normal points into the bay, toward the part it holds. Symmetry 0: a mate's angle_deg is the tilt about the side-screw axis. Its partner bolts against this face (the camera's side face, fpv-camera-micro-19mm.side_face_*); a part wider than the bay cannot.

interfaces.note: Female: the plate's side-screw hole receives the screw of a part that bolts on from OUTSIDE (a camera cage's ear, which carries the head). Origin where the side-screw axis meets the plate's OUTER face; the normal points away from the bay, toward the ear. Symmetry 0: a mate's angle_deg turns the part about the side-screw axis (0 = the part's x_axis forward). The two outer faces stand camera_bay_width_mm + 2 × side_plate_thickness_mm apart (24 mm at the defaults).

Origin where the side-screw axis meets the plate's OUTER face; the normal points away from the bay, toward the ear. The two outer faces stand camera_bay_width_mm + 2 × side_plate_thickness_mm apart (24 mm at the defaults).

Female: the top plate's four holes (on the VTX standoffs below) receive the screws of a part seated on the plate's UPPER face (a VTX, or an antenna mount's two-bolt foot on one 20 mm row), which carries the heads. Origin at the pattern centre on the upper face; normal up. Symmetry 4: rotation_index picks the row a two-bolt foot uses. The pattern is cited (GEPRC MK5); its fore-aft position is the convention rear_mount_x_mm.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (P4-STD lane, 2026-10-02); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: A COTS frame CLASS, not a design. The entry states only facts frames of this class share (225 mm motor-to-motor, 16 × 16 mm M3 motor mounts, a 30.5 × 30.5 mm stack, a 19–20 mm camera bay, 20 mm battery straps), cited from vendor listings. It copies no branded frame's outline, arm shape or plate geometry, and it carries no CAD. Positions that are not shared facts (camera axis, top-plate height, a squashed-X stretch) are parameters with conventional defaults.
